record.field: SELECT a.aufnr, a.auart, p.matnr, a.werks, k.gamng, p.meins, k.gmein, k.gstrp, k.gltrp, a.ernam, CASE WHEN j.stat = 'I0045' AND j.inact = ' ' THEN 'TECO' ELSE 'NOT TECO' END AS teco_status FROM aufk a JOIN afko k ON a.aufnr = k.aufnr JOIN afpo p ON a.aufnr = p.aufnr JOIN jest j ON a.objnr = j.objnr AND j.stat = 'I0045' WHERE a.autyp = '10' limit 100
